paper_title: An Easy and Effective Method to Modulate Molecular Energy Level of the Polymer Based on Benzodithiophene for the Application in Polymer Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2013 - Zhang - An Easy and Effective Method to Modulate Molecular Energy Level of the Polymer Based on/auto/Advanced Materials - 2013 - Zhang - An Easy and Effective Method to Modulate Molecular Energy Level of the Polymer Based on.md

knowledge_points.content: Substituting alkylthienyl side chains with meta-alkoxy-phenyl groups on the benzodithiophene (BDT) unit is an effective molecular design strategy to lower the HOMO energy level of conjugated polymers.
knowledge_points.evidence: In order to extend the functionalities of the 2D structure, a meta-alkoxy-phenyl-substituted BDT (BDT-m-OP) building block was designed and employed in constructing D-A polymers... the polymer's HOMO level can be reduced distinctly.

knowledge_points.content: The polymer solar cell based on PBT-OP achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 7.50%, representing a 35% improvement over the PBT-T-based device which had a PCE of 5.56%.
knowledge_points.evidence: consequently, the PCE of the corresponding PSC devices can be improved from 5.56% to 7.50%... which is ~35% higher than that of the device of PBT-T.

knowledge_points.content: The replacement of alkylthienyl groups with meta-alkoxy-phenyl groups on the BDT unit increases the open-circuit voltage (Voc) of the resulting polymer solar cells from 0.60 V to 0.78 V.
knowledge_points.evidence: Voc of the PSC device can be significantly enhanced from 0.60 V to 0.78 V... The improved Voc of the device of PBT-OP can be ascribed to the deeper HOMO level of PBT-OP than PBT-T.

knowledge_points.content: PBT-OP exhibits a deeper HOMO level of -5.17 eV compared to -4.95 eV for PBT-T, while their LUMO levels remain nearly identical at -3.14 eV and -3.12 eV, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO levels of PBT-T and PBT-OP are -4.95 eV and -5.17 eV, and their LUMO levels are -3.12 eV and -3.14 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Grazing Incidence X-ray Diffraction (GIXD) results indicate that PBT-T and PBT-OP neat films have similar molecular packing, with (010) pi-pi stacking reflections at approximately 1.6 inverse Angstroms, corresponding to a d-spacing of 3.9 Angstroms.
knowledge_points.evidence: both two neat films show (100) lamellar packing reflections at ~0.3 Å−1 (corresponding to a d-spacing of ~20.9 Å) and (010) π-π stacking reflections at ~1.6 Å−1 (corresponding to a d-spacing of 3.9 Å).

knowledge_points.content: The use of 3% (v/v) 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a processing solvent additive is critical for optimizing the morphology of PBT-OP:PC71BM blends, as it helps to diminish large-scale aggregations and form a nanoscale interpenetrating network.
knowledge_points.evidence: after the use of 3% DIO, these big size aggregations of polymer and PC71BM are diminished... nanoscale phase separation and interpenetrating network can be formed under the assistance of DIO.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility of PBT-OP, measured by the space-charge-limited current (SCLC) method, is 5.85 x 10^-3 cm^2/Vs, which is higher than the 3.81 x 10^-3 cm^2/Vs recorded for PBT-T.
knowledge_points.evidence: hole mobilities from PBT-T (3.81 × 10^−3 cm^2/V s) to PBT-OP (5.85 × 10^−3 cm^2/V s) measured by space-charge-limited current (SCLC) method.

knowledge_points.content: Resonant soft X-ray scattering (R-SoXS) measurements demonstrate that DIO-processed blend films exhibit a hierarchical phase separation with a bimodal distribution of domain sizes, including a small length scale of approximately 26 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: Upon adding DIO, the ξ of these two blends... all showed bimodal distribution... at high q with ξ of 26 nm for both blends. Such a hierarchical phase separation is observed in other blends too and is considered to be favorable for charge separation and transport.

knowledge_points.content: PBT-T and PBT-OP are synthesized through Stille-coupling polymerization using toluene as the solvent and Pd(PPh3)4 as the catalyst.
knowledge_points.evidence: PBT-T and PBT-OP were synthesized via a typical Stille-coupling reaction using toluene as solvent and Pd(PPh3)4 as catalyst.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgaps (Eg) for PBT-T and PBT-OP thin films are determined to be 1.67 eV and 1.70 eV, respectively, based on their absorption edges.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Eg opt values of PBT-T and PBT-OP are 1.67 and 1.70 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) indicates that both PBT-T and PBT-OP polymers are thermally stable up to 380 °C, defined by a 5% weight loss threshold.
knowledge_points.evidence: The thermogravimetric analysis measurements (TGA) showed that the onset temperatures with 5% weight-loss (Td) of PBT-T and PBT-OP are all over 380 °C respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The study utilizes a conventional bulk heterojunction (BHJ) device structure consisting of ITO/PEDOT:PSS/polymer:PC71BM/Ca/Al.
knowledge_points.evidence: BHJ PSC devices with a configuration of ITO/PEDOT: PSS/polymer: PC71BM /Ca/Al were fabricated.

knowledge_points.content: Compared to fluorination, the introduction of meta-alkoxy-phenyl side chains is presented as a simpler synthetic route to modulate energy levels without the drawbacks of multi-step synthesis and low yields.
knowledge_points.evidence: Although the use of fluorination has led to great successes, this method also causes a few drawbacks... multi-step synthesis and low yield for the fluorination moieties... to develop new method to modulate molecular energy levels through an easier and more efficient approach.
